summary: Merged the frozen T033 contract with the 2026-09-16 Owner amendments (#3 and #7) into a single unified contract body. Removed the dual-layer expression (FROZEN_FROM_BASELINE_6C31778 status plus separate Owner amendment block). Folded Decision 3 (Robinhood finality policy using the RPC finalized tag, unfinalized window finalized+1..latest, fail-closed on finalized unavailability / fallback / error / endpoint ancestry disagreement, no automatic fallback to fixed confirmations, confirmations=12 retained only as EXPERIMENTAL_NOT_LIVE_APPROVED placeholder, explicit finality-policy injection in tests, reason codes finalized_unavailable / finalized_ancestry_disagreement / finality_tag_unavailable / FINALIZED_ANCESTRY_VIOLATION) and Decision 7 (FINALIZED_ANCESTRY_VIOLATION halt, append-only critical-incident candidate recorder, preservation of old raw partitions and canonical generations, new fork/observation as new append-only evidence, escalation to Phase 8, superseding canonical generation only after human incident declaration and re-checking, finalized raw evidence never rewritten including during a critical incident) into the Outcome, Deliverables, Acceptance, Must-not, and References sections. Added the Binding direction reference subsection listing the Owner decisions and the /tmp/owner_decision_T033.txt source per Decision 5.
rationale: This merge conforms to Owner Decision 5 (all P03 tasks) which requires collapsing the FROZEN_FROM_BASELINE_6C31778 dual-layer expression into a single unified contract body so that the Developer cannot choose between the frozen baseline and the Owner amendment. The merged Outcome, Deliverables, Acceptance, and Must-not sections explicitly carry every binding clause from Decision 3 (Robinhood finality policy) and Decision 7 (FINALIZED_ANCESTRY_VIOLATION critical incident) so the Developer has only one contract body to execute. The Binding direction reference subsection at the end preserves the audit trail back to /tmp/owner_decision_T033.txt without functioning as a second source of binding direction. Per the CONTRACT_MISMATCH triage classification, only todo/phases/P03-ingestion-and-storage/T033.md was edited; no task status, attempt counter, evidence pointer, commit SHA, runtime model, approval datum, workflow/controller code, other task contract, docs/intent, or docs/spec was changed.
